messages:
maya.chen: Quick heads-up — we need an urgent docs hotfix for yesterday's outage. The status page URL on the incident note is pointing to the old slug. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — contains status page link + a short workaround section.

alex_g: thanks. Can you paste the exact status page URL we should use? I can do a quick review.

maya.chen: new URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-09-21 — currently the doc links to /incidents/2026-09-21 which 404s. Also note the SDK snippet under "Recovering from OOM" had an incorrect param.

sam.patel: which SDK snippet? I can fix the param and run a deploy-preview.

maya.chen: in the python example, we used `session_token=` instead of `api_key=`. tiny change.

priya: pinging @alex_g and @sam.patel as reviewers. We should not merge until the docs preview is up and the incident postmortem page is live (we're coordinating with Ops). Suggested plan: update link + fix SDK snippet, run preview, then merge after CI and one approval.

alex_g: ok i'll review in ~20m. quick checklist: 1) correct status URL 2) add a one-paragraph Known Issue with workaround 3) ensure the sample output still matches.

maya.chen: adding known-issue text in the PR description. Workaround to include: a short command to flush the local KV cache and the suggestion to use the lower-memory model variant until allocation stabilizes.

sam.patel: pushed a small commit to the PR changing `session_token` -> `api_key` and added a code comment. snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate("Tell me a joke")
```

docsbot: Deploy preview created for PR #4823: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.ai — build passed.

ci-bot: CI: docs build ✔️, linkcheck ❌ (warning: external link redirect). See logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876/logs

alex_g: saw the linkcheck warning — it's the status redirect, but that new status URL is final. Add a short note in PR explaining the redirect and why we accept it. Otherwise LGTM from me for content.

maya.chen: done — added note about the status page redirect and included the Ops cross-ref (INC-2026-09-21).

priya: we need a backport to the v1.4 docs branch (customers on dedicated infra still on that stable tree). Can someone open the backport PR after merge?

sam.patel: I can open a backport PR and mark it for fast-track.

maya.chen: propose merge timing: merge once we have 1 approval (alex), CI green, and Ops confirms postmortem page is published (target ~10:30 UTC). If Ops delays, we hold merge and update the PR with a TODO.

alex_g: approving now (commented on PR).

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✔️ (linkcheck warning acknowledged).

docsbot: Deploy preview updated: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.ai (preview includes Known Issue section and SDK snippet fix).

maya.chen: Ops confirmed postmortem page live: https://ops.redwood.ai/postmortem/INC-2026-09-21 at 10:27 UTC. merging now.

sam.patel: Merged main -> added backport PR #4824 targeting v1.4. Marked as high-priority.

alex_g: quick note for changelog: this is a hotfix (docs only) — include reference to INC-2026-09-21 and the workaround steps.

maya.chen: done. Thanks everyone :paw_prints: — closing thread after backport lands.

priya: thanks all — please watch for customer slack threads referencing the old link; we should have the support playbook updated too.

sam.patel: backport merged and cherry-picked — CI green.

maya.chen: verified production docs show correct status link and updated SDK snippet. all good.

alex_g: great. I'll add a small eval to make sure the example output still renders correctly in the docs site.

maya.chen: perfect — locking the doc for edits until morning to avoid churn.
